Eusa Status Z Resource Update Eusa Status
PUT
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/eusaStatus/:eusaStatusId

Updates the EUSA status based on the specified status ID

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
eusaStatusId
int32
REQUIRED

The EUSA status ID

APPLICATION/JSON
BODY

The EUSA status details

version
object
REQUIRED
acceptedStatus
boolean

A Boolean value that specifies the EUSA status. If set to true, the EUSA is accepted. If set to false, the EUSA is in an 'agreement pending' state. The default value is false.

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
id
int32

System-generated identifier for the EUSA status

version
object
REQUIRED
acceptedStatus
boolean

A Boolean value that specifies the EUSA status. If set to true, the EUSA is accepted. If set to false, the EUSA is in an 'agreement pending' state. The default value is false.
